target.title: fix(review): keep maturity labels out of issue lease revisions
target.body:
## Summary
- exclude ClawSweeper-managed `maturity:stable` from issue source-revision hashing
- preserve ordinary label, protected label, and `proof: override` revision changes
- add focused regression coverage for the review-start lease key

This keeps ClawSweeper's own advisory maturity labeling from invalidating an in-flight exact-head review-start lease. It does not weaken `freshExactHeadReviewStartLease`, change pull-request head-SHA coordination, or alter unrelated label semantics.

Context: the exact-head source-revision lease path came from https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/501, and the managed maturity label came from https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/372. Thanks @yetval for the report and live timeline.

## Validation
- `node --test test/review-comment-rendering.test.ts`
- `pnpm run check`

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/issues/507
